create.name: Michael and Jahna
create.bio:
Michael and Jahna Perricone are a married duo from Pacific Palisades in Los Angeles who lead sound baths built around antique Himalayan singing bowls, many of them several centuries old. Jahna trained as a mindfulness facilitator through UCLA's Mindful Awareness Research Center and runs the mindfulness programme at the Center for Conscious Creatives; in their sessions she offers spoken guidance and wordless vocal toning. Michael, who spent decades as a sound mixer for film and records, plays the bowls, gongs, guitar and flute and shapes the overall sound.

They call their events Transformances, a mix of guided practice and live performance. Their monthly Sonic Sunday sound baths are also shared online, and they have appeared at LACMA, the Getty and SXSW and led retreats abroad. They wrote and produced The Journey, a 360-degree dome film that uses the same bowls and voice as their live work and has been shown at planetariums and film festivals. Their recordings range from instrumental bowl albums to a set of guided mindfulness practices, and on Insight Timer they share sound meditations and a nine-day course on creativity.

courses.title: Ignite Your Creativity!
courses.description: A nine-day Insight Timer course from Michael and Jahna that pairs short mindfulness guidance with singing bowls and voice, aimed at opening up creative flow. Each day is a separate session to listen to in order.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Spring Into Mindfulness (album)
courses.description: A downloadable album of guided mindfulness practices led by Jahna, with mindful listening to the antique bowls woven through. The tracks run from short to longer sits, so beginners can start small and build up.

courses.title: Sonic Sunday - March 2024 Recording
courses.description: A full recording of one of the duo's monthly Sonic Sunday sound baths, recorded in March 2024, to download and play at home. Their Sonic Sundays combine antique singing bowls, gongs and voice.

free_resources.title: Michael and Jahna on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free sound meditations from the duo, with Himalayan singing bowls, gentle breath guidance and Jahna's voice. Listen in the app or on the web.

Couple listed as one entry under the name they use, Michael and Jahna; photos show both of them together (not one person), as is their public image.
The YouTube link in their site footer (@michaelandjahna8386) returns 404; their active channel is @michaelandjahna444 (found by search, clearly theirs from the Sonic Sunday uploads).

Some customer testimonials on their home page mention insomnia; none of that is used in the listing.
